name: Sec1Security
description: Sec1 Security Scanner offers comprehensive scanning capabilities, allowing you to detect vulnerabilities in FOSS repositories, perform SAST scans on source code, and trigger DAST scans against deployed applications
author: Sec1

inputs.name: serviceConnection
inputs.label: Sec1 API Key
inputs.helpMarkDown: Choose service connection for Sec1 API Key

inputs.name: enableSCA
inputs.label: Enable SCA Scan
inputs.helpMarkDown: Check this box to enable Software Composition Analysis (SCA) scan

inputs.name: enableSAST
inputs.label: Enable SAST Scan
inputs.helpMarkDown: Check this box to enable Static Application Security Testing (SAST) scan

inputs.name: enableDAST
inputs.label: Enable DAST Scan
inputs.helpMarkDown: Check this box to enable Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) scan. Requires a DAST Configuration ID created in the Sec1 portal.

inputs.name: dastTargetUrl
inputs.label: DAST Target URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: The fully-qualified URL of the deployed application to scan (e.g. https://staging.example.com). The scan is launched against this target.

inputs.name: dastScanType
inputs.label: DAST Scan Type
inputs.helpMarkDown: Quick scans run faster with lighter coverage. Deep scans are more thorough but take longer. Defaults to Quick.

inputs.name: enableApiSecurity
inputs.label: Enable API Security Scan
inputs.helpMarkDown: Check this box to enable API Security scanning. Requires an API Security Configuration ID created in the Sec1 portal.

inputs.name: apiSecurityConfigId
inputs.label: API Security Config ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: The API Security Configuration ID created in the Sec1 portal. The scan is triggered against this configuration.

inputs.name: asyncScan
inputs.label: Run scans asynchronously
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, the SCA scan is triggered fire-and-forget: the pipeline does not wait for results. Ignored when Threshold Check is enabled, since thresholds require scan results to evaluate.

inputs.name: tag
inputs.label: Tag
inputs.helpMarkDown: Provide a tag to identify this scan. If not provided, 'default' will be used

inputs.name: thresholdCheck
inputs.label: Enable the Threshold Check
inputs.helpMarkDown: Check this box to enable the Threshold Check in your pipeline and it will fail if vulnerability threshold level crosses.

inputs.name: critical
inputs.label: Enter a threshold value for Critical
inputs.helpMarkDown: Enter a threshold value for Critical

inputs.name: high
inputs.label: Enter a threshold value for High
inputs.helpMarkDown: Enter a threshold value for High

inputs.name: medium
inputs.label: Enter a threshold value for Medium
inputs.helpMarkDown: Enter a threshold value for Medium

inputs.name: low
inputs.label: Enter a threshold value for Low
inputs.helpMarkDown: Enter a threshold value for low
